name: World of Hyatt Credit Card
signup_bonus: 30,000 points after $3,000 in purchases in the first 3 months. Separately, earn 2 total points per dollar on normally 1-point purchases for the first 6 months, on up to $15,000 in spending.
perks: The card earns 4 points per dollar on qualifying Hyatt purchases; Hyatt membership can earn additional base points.
One Category 1–4 free night after each cardmember anniversary; another after $15,000 in calendar-year spending.
audit_note: Only the facts shown below were confirmed at the linked official source. Other terms remain unverified; offers may change or vary by applicant.
